fields.name: accountBalances
fields.short: The various balances for the account.

fields.name: accountID
fields.short: ID of the account.

fields.name: accountIdentifications
fields.short: The canoncial identifiers for the account.

fields.name: accountName
fields.short: Name for the account

fields.name: accountNames
fields.short: Optional account names set by the account holder.

fields.name: accountSupplierName
fields.short: The payment account supplier name.

fields.name: accountType
fields.short: The type of account e.g.

fields.name: availableBalance
fields.short: The current available balance of the account.

fields.name: availableBalanceMinorUnits
fields.short: The available balance expressed in the currency’s minor units (e.g.

fields.name: balance
fields.short: Balance of the account.

fields.name: balanceMinorUnits
fields.short: Balance of the account expressed in the currency’s minor units (e.g.

fields.name: bankName
fields.short: The bank name for external accounts

fields.name: consentID
fields.short: The ID of the consent used to connect the external account.

fields.name: consolidatedAccountInformation
fields.short: Summary information regarding account balances of the overall account provided by the bank.

fields.name: createdByDisplayName
fields.short: Either the name of the user, merchant token or api key that created the account

fields.name: currency
fields.short: Currency of the account in ISO 4217 format

fields.name: defaultPaymentRail
fields.short: Indicates the default payment rail for this account.

fields.name: description
fields.short: Product name as defined by the financial institution for this account.

fields.name: details
fields.short: Supplementary specifications that might be provided by the Bank.

fields.name: displayName
fields.short: Gets a unique display name for the payment account.

fields.name: expiryDate
fields.short: The date that the external account will expire

fields.name: externalAccountIcon
fields.short: The Icon for external accounts

fields.name: format
fields.short: File format to save the statement as.

fields.name: fromDate
fields.short: Minimum transaction date for the statement.

fields.name: id
fields.short: Unique id for the account.

fields.name: inserted
fields.short: Timestamp when the account was created.

fields.name: isArchived
fields.short: Indicates whether the account is archived.

fields.name: isConnectedAccount
fields.short: Indicates if the payment account is an externally connected account.

fields.name: isDefault
fields.short: Is the default account

fields.name: isTrustAccount
fields.short: Indicates if the payment account is a trust account.

fields.name: isVirtual
fields.short: True if the account is a virtual account.

fields.name: lastUpdated
fields.short: Timestamp when the account was last updated.

fields.name: merchantID
fields.short: The ID of the merchant that owns the account.

fields.name: merchantName
fields.short: The name of the merchant that owns the account.

fields.name: nickname
fields.short: Nickname of the account that was provided by the account owner.

fields.name: physicalAccountID
fields.short: For virtual accounts this is the ID of the physical account that the virtual account is linked to.

fields.name: roleIDs
fields.short: Optional list of role IDs that will get access to the payment account when created.

fields.name: rules
fields.short: The list of rules associated with this account.

fields.name: submittedPayoutsBalance
fields.short: Total of the payouts that have been submitted for processing.

fields.name: submittedPayoutsBalanceMinorUnits
fields.short: The balance of the submitted payouts expressed in the currency’s minor units (e.g.

fields.name: summary
fields.short: Gets a summary of the payments account's most important properties.

fields.name: supplierPhysicalAccountID
fields.short: For internal use only.

fields.name: supplierSepaInstantStatus
fields.short: Indicates the status of the SEPA Instant payment rail for this account.

fields.name: toDate
fields.short: Maximum transaction date for the statement.

fields.name: type
fields.short: Specifies the type of account e.g.

fields.name: xeroBankFeedConnectionStatus
fields.short: States the status of the Xero bank feed connection, if applicable.

fields.name: xeroUnsynchronisedTransactionsCount
fields.short: Indicates the number of unsynchronised transactions with Xero

fields.name: authorisersRequiredCount
fields.short: The number of authorisers required for this beneficiary.

fields.name: canAuthorise
fields.short: True if the beneficiary can be authorised by the user who loaded it.

fields.name: canUpdate
fields.short: True if the beneficiary can be updated by the user who loaded it.

fields.name: currency

fields.name: merchantID

fields.name: name

fields.name: sourceAccountIDs
fields.short: ID of the accounts which are authorised to act as a source for the beneficiary.

fields.name: theirReference
fields.short: The reference that will be used by default as TheirReference when creating payouts to this beneficiary if no TheirReference is specified for the payout.

fields.name: isPayerAuthenticationRequired
fields.short: Gets set to true if 3-D Secure payer authentication is required for a payment.

fields.name: isSoftDecline
fields.short: Gets set to true if the card processor flagged the transaction as having failed address or card security number verification.

fields.name: payerAuthenticationAccessToken
fields.short: If a card payment response indicates a 3-D Secure payer authentication is required this field holds the access token to POST when performing the redirect.

fields.name: payerAuthenticationMerchantData
fields.short: If a card payment response indicates a 3-D Secure payer authentication this field may get set in order to transfer information back to the "authenticationcallback" method that gets called automatically after a successful payer authenticati…

fields.name: payerAuthenticationUrl
fields.short: If a card payment response indicates a 3-D Secure payer authentication is required this field holds the URL to redirect the payer to their issuing bank.

fields.name: payerAuthenticationWindowHeight
fields.short: If a card payment response indicates a 3-D Secure payer authentication is required this field holds the requested height of the iframe used to hold the challenge.

fields.name: payerAuthenticationWindowWidth
fields.short: If a card payment response indicates a 3-D Secure payer authentication is required this field holds the requested width of the iframe used to hold the challenge.

fields.name: paymentRequestCallbackUrl
fields.short: The callback URL that was set when the payment request was created.

fields.name: threeDSRedirectUrl
fields.short: Checkout.com require a redirect for 3DS authentication.

fields.name: isPayerAuthenticationRequired
fields.short: Gets set to true if 3-D Secure payer authentication is required for a payment.

fields.name: isSoftDecline
fields.short: Gets set to true if the card processor flagged the transaction as having failed address or card security number verification.

fields.name: payerAuthenticationAccessToken
fields.short: If a card payment response indicates a 3-D Secure payer authentication is required this field holds the access token to POST when performing the redirect.

fields.name: payerAuthenticationMerchantData
fields.short: If a card payment response indicates a 3-D Secure payer authentication this field may get set in order to transfer information back to the "authenticationcallback" method that gets called automatically after a successful payer authenticati…

fields.name: payerAuthenticationUrl
fields.short: If a card payment response indicates a 3-D Secure payer authentication is required this field holds the URL to redirect the payer to their issuing bank.

fields.name: payerAuthenticationWindowHeight
fields.short: If a card payment response indicates a 3-D Secure payer authentication is required this field holds the requested height of the iframe used to hold the challenge.

fields.name: payerAuthenticationWindowWidth
fields.short: If a card payment response indicates a 3-D Secure payer authentication is required this field holds the requested width of the iframe used to hold the challenge.

fields.name: paymentRequestCallbackUrl
fields.short: The callback URL that was set when the payment request was created.

fields.name: threeDSRedirectUrl
fields.short: Checkout.com require a redirect for 3DS authentication.

fields.name: authorisationUrl
fields.short: The URL the authorising user needs to be redirected to in order to get the open banking consent token.

fields.name: callbackUrl
fields.short: Optional callback URL that the end user performing the open banking authorisation will be redirected to on completion.

fields.name: consentID
fields.short: The ID of the open banking consent.

fields.name: emailAddress
fields.short: The email address that identifies the end user that will be authorising the open banking consent request.

fields.name: failureCallbackUrl
fields.short: Optional callback URL for open banking consent authorisation failure.

fields.name: institutionID
fields.short: The institution ID the open banking consent is being requested for.

fields.name: isConnectedAccounts
fields.short: Optional setting.

fields.name: merchantID
fields.short: The ID of the merchant the consent token is being created to be used with.

fields.name: provider
fields.short: Lists the supported card and PIS processors.

fields.name: successWebHookUrl
fields.short: A web hook URL to send an HTTP request to when the open banking consent is successfuly authorised.

fields.name: iban
fields.short: IBAN of the customer's bank account in case of EUR account.

fields.name: id
fields.short: Internal ID of the mandate.

fields.name: inserted
fields.short: The timestamp this mandate was created at.

fields.name: isRecurring
fields.short: Whether this mandate is single-use or recurring.

fields.name: lastName
fields.short: Customer's last name.

fields.name: lastUpdated
fields.short: The timestamp this mandate was last updated at.

fields.name: merchantID
fields.short: Internal ID of this mandate's merchant.

fields.name: postalCode
fields.short: Customer's postal code.

fields.name: reference
fields.short: Reference assigned to this mandate.

fields.name: sortCode
fields.short: Sort code of the customer's bank account in case of GBP account.

fields.name: status
fields.short: General status of this mandate.

fields.name: supplierBankAccountID
fields.short: ID that the supplier assigned to this mandate's bank account.

fields.name: supplierCustomerID
fields.short: ID that the supplier assigned to this mandate's customer.

fields.name: supplierMandateID
fields.short: ID that the supplier assigned to this mandate.

fields.name: supplierName
fields.short: Name of the supplier used to create this mandate.

fields.name: supplierStatus
fields.short: Last status that the supplier reported for this mandate.

fields.name: accountCurrencies
fields.short: The list of currencies that the merchant has accounts for.

fields.name: canHaveTrustAccounts
fields.short: Trust accounts are a special type of account that allow the account name to be trusted for use in statements and verification of payee checks.

fields.name: cardPaymentProcessor
fields.short: Name of the card payment processor.

fields.name: companyID
fields.short: The Company ID recorded in the Compliance system.

fields.name: displayQrOnHostedPay
fields.short: Indicates if a QR Code containing the payment link should be displayed on the hosted payment page.

fields.name: hostedPayVersion
fields.short: The version of the hosted payment page to use with the merchant.

fields.name: id
fields.short: Unique ID for the merchant.

fields.name: inserted
fields.short: Timestamp the merchant was added to MoneyMoov.

fields.name: isBlocked
fields.short: The merchant is blocked from making payments (payouts).

fields.name: isExited
fields.short: The merchant has formally terminated their relationship and is no longer a customer.

fields.name: isSuspended
fields.short: The merchant has temporarily suspended their own account.

fields.name: jurisdiction
fields.short: The jurisdiction the merchant entity is incorporated or established in.

fields.name: logoUrlPng
fields.short: The CDN URL of the merchant's logo in PNG format.

fields.name: logoUrlSvg
fields.short: The CDN URL of the merchant's logo in SVG format.

fields.name: merchantCategoryCode
fields.short: The industry code that represents the merchant's primary trading activity.

fields.name: name
fields.short: The registered business name of the merchant.

fields.name: notes
fields.short: The notes field is an optional free text field that can be used to store any additional information about the merchant.

fields.name: paymentAccountLimit
fields.short: The maximum number of payment accounts that can be created for the Merchant.

fields.name: reason
fields.short: The reason for the suspension.

fields.name: shortName
fields.short: A URL friendly shortish name for the merchant.

fields.name: supportedPaymentMethodsList
fields.short: The payment methods that are configured and supported for this merchant.

fields.name: suspensionReason
fields.short: The reason for the suspension, provided by the merchant.

fields.name: tags
fields.short: An optional list of descriptive tags that can be used on merchant entities such as payment requests.

fields.name: timeZoneId
fields.short: The IANA (Internet Assigned Numbers Authority) time zone identifier of the merchant.

fields.name: tradingName
fields.short: An optional trading name.

fields.name: webHookLimit
fields.short: The maximum number of web hooks that can be created for the Merchant.

fields.name: yourRoleName
fields.short: The name of the role for the identity that loaded the merchant record.

fields.name: authenticationMethods
fields.short: A list of authentication types allowed to authorise the merchant token.

fields.name: authorisations
fields.short: A list of users who have successfully authorised the latest version of the beneficiary.

fields.name: authorisersCompletedCount
fields.short: The number of distinct authorisers that have authorised the merchant token.

fields.name: authorisersRequiredCount
fields.short: The number of authorisers required for this merchant token.

fields.name: canAuthorise
fields.short: True if the merchant token can be authorised by the user who loaded it.

fields.name: description
fields.short: Token description

fields.name: expiresAt
fields.short: Optional.

fields.name: hasCurrentUserAuthorised
fields.short: True if the beneficiary was loaded for a user and that user has already authorised the latest version of the beneficiary.

fields.name: hmacAlgorithm
fields.short: Optional shared secret algorithm to use for HMAC authentication.

fields.name: ipAddressWhitelist
fields.short: Optional.

fields.name: isArchived
fields.short: Indicates whether the merchant token is archived.

fields.name: isEnabled
fields.short: If set to false the merchant token will not be accepted to authorise a request.

fields.name: merchantID
fields.short: The merchant id to add to the token

fields.name: permissionTypes
fields.short: The permissions that the merchant token supports.

fields.name: requestSignatureVersion
fields.short: Represent the version of the overall merchant token.

fields.name: sharedSecretAlgorithm
fields.short: Optional shared secret algorithm to use for HMAC authentication.

fields.name: sharedSecretBase64
fields.short: The base 64 encoded shared secret that is used for request authentication with an HMAC.

fields.name: token
fields.short: The JWT merchant token.

fields.name: amount
fields.short: The amount of money to request.

fields.name: amountPending
fields.short: Total amount that has been authorised but not settled for this payment request.

fields.name: amountReceived
fields.short: Total amount received for this payment request.

fields.name: amountRefunded
fields.short: Total amount refunded for this payment request.

fields.name: autoSendReceipt
fields.short: If set to true, a receipt will be automatically sent to the CustomerEmailAddress when payments are received.

fields.name: baseOriginUrl
fields.short: For card payments the origin of the payment page needs to be set in advance.

fields.name: callbackUrl
fields.short: Once a payment is processed, or a notification of an inbound payment is received, a callback request will be made to this URL.

fields.name: cardAuthorizeOnly
fields.short: For card payments the default behaviour is to authorise and capture the payment at the same time.

fields.name: cardCreateToken
fields.short: For card payments a payment attempt can be used to create a reusable token for subsequent payments.

fields.name: cardCreateTokenMode
fields.short: This specifies whether user consent will be taken before tokenising card or not.

fields.name: cardIgnoreCVN
fields.short: If set to true the card payment gateway will be directed to proceed with a payment even if the card verification number check fails.

fields.name: cardNoPayerAuthentication
fields.short: If set to true for card payments no attempt will be made to use payer authentication (3-D Secure and equivalent).

fields.name: cardProcessorMerchantID
fields.short: Optional field that if specified indicates the processor merchant ID that should be used to process any card payments.

fields.name: cardStripePaymentIntentID
fields.short: If Stripe is being used as the card payment processor this property is used to hold the Stripe payment intent ID.

fields.name: cardStripePaymentIntentSecret
fields.short: If Stripe is being used as the card payment processor this property is used to hold the Stripe payment intent client secret.

fields.name: cardTransmitRawDetails
fields.short: If set to true for card payments the sensitive card number and card verification number will be transmitted directly rather than being tokenised.

fields.name: currency
fields.short: The currency of the request.

fields.name: customFields
fields.short: A list of custom fields attached to the payment request.

fields.name: customerEmailAddress
fields.short: Optional email address for the customer.

fields.name: customerID
fields.short: An optional customer identifier for the payment request.

fields.name: description
fields.short: An optional description for the payment request.

fields.name: directDebitPayment
fields.short: Contains information about a Direct Debit payment attempt for a payment request.

fields.name: dueDate
fields.short: The due date for the payment request.

fields.name: failureCallbackUrl
fields.short: Optional callback URL for payment failures that can occur when the payer is redirected away from the payment page.

fields.name: fieldDisplaySettings
fields.short: A list of field display settings that control which fields are displayed to the payer.

fields.name: hostedPayCheckoutUrl
fields.short: This is a convenience link generated for payment requests whose merchants are using hosted payment pages.

fields.name: ignoreAddressVerification
fields.short: If set to true the card payment gateway will be directed to proceed with a payment even if the address verification checks fails.

fields.name: inserted
fields.short: The timestamp the payment request was created at.

fields.name: insertedSortable
fields.short: The Inserted timestamp output as a sortable string https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/standard/base-types/standard-date-and-time-format-strings#UniversalSortable Format also supported natively by Javascript https://tc39.es/ecma262/#se…

fields.name: isArchived
fields.short: Indicates whether the payment request is archived.

fields.name: jwk
fields.short: The jwk containing the public key used to verify the signature of the payment request.

fields.name: lastUpdated
fields.short: The timestamp the payment request was last updated at.

fields.name: lightningInvoice
fields.short: Bitcoin Lightning invoice for the payment request.

fields.name: lightningInvoiceExpiresAt
fields.short: Date and time of expiration of the lightning invoice.

fields.name: merchantDirectDebitMandateID
fields.short: Optional ID of the direct debit mandate associated with this payment request.

fields.name: merchantID
fields.short: The ID of the merchant to create the payment request for.

fields.name: merchantTokenDescription
fields.short: Description of the merchant token in case the Payment request was created using a merchant token.

fields.name: notificationRoleIDs
fields.short: A list of roles whose members will receive notifications about this payment request.

fields.name: orderID
fields.short: An optional order ID for the payment request.

fields.name: partialPaymentMethod
fields.short: The approach to use, or not, for accepting partial payments.

fields.name: partialPaymentSteps
fields.short: An optional comma separated list of partial payment amounts.

fields.name: paymentAttempts
fields.short: The payment attempts made against this payment request.

fields.name: paymentMethods
fields.short: The payment methods that the payment request supports.

fields.name: paymentProcessor
fields.short: If the card payment option is enabled this field indicates which card processor the merchant is set up to use.

fields.name: payrunID
fields.short: The ID of a payrun that needs an account top up.

fields.name: pispAccountID
fields.short: The payment account ID to use to receive payment initiation payments.

fields.name: priorityBankID
fields.short: The ID of the bank that is set as the priority bank for display on pay element.

fields.name: sandboxSettleDelayInSeconds
fields.short: Sandbox only.

fields.name: shippingAddressCity
fields.short: Optionally the city of the customer's shipping address.

fields.name: shippingAddressCountryCode
fields.short: Optionally the country code of the customer's shipping address.

fields.name: shippingAddressCounty
fields.short: Optionally the state or county of the customer's shipping address.

fields.name: shippingAddressLine1
fields.short: Optionally the first line of the customer's shipping address.

fields.name: shippingAddressLine2
fields.short: Optionally the second line of the customer's shipping address.

fields.name: shippingAddressPostCode
fields.short: Optionally the post code of the customer's shipping address.

fields.name: shippingEmail
fields.short: Optionally the shipping email address for the customer.

fields.name: shippingFirstName
fields.short: Optionally the first name of the customer's shipping address.

fields.name: shippingLastName
fields.short: Optionally the last name of the customer's shipping address.

fields.name: shippingPhone
fields.short: Optionally the shipping phone number for the customer.

fields.name: status
fields.short: The current status of the payment request.

fields.name: successWebHookUrl
fields.short: If a payment event results in the payment request being classified as fully paid this success webhook URL will be invoked.

fields.name: tagIds
fields.short: An optional list of tag ids to add to the payment request

fields.name: tags
fields.short: An optional list of descriptive tags attached to the payment request.

fields.name: title
fields.short: A generic field to contain any additional data that the merchant wishes to store against the payment request.

fields.name: useHostedPaymentPage
fields.short: If set to true, and the merchant is configured for hosted payment pages, the base and callback URLs will be set to use the hosted payment page.

fields.name: amount
fields.short: The amount of money to request.

fields.name: amountPending
fields.short: Total amount that has been authorised but not settled for this payment request.

fields.name: amountReceived
fields.short: Total amount received for this payment request.

fields.name: amountRefunded
fields.short: Total amount refunded for this payment request.

fields.name: autoSendReceipt
fields.short: If set to true, a receipt will be automatically sent to the CustomerEmailAddress when payments are received.

fields.name: baseOriginUrl
fields.short: For card payments the origin of the payment page needs to be set in advance.

fields.name: callbackUrl
fields.short: Once a payment is processed, or a notification of an inbound payment is received, a callback request will be made to this URL.

fields.name: cardAuthorizeOnly
fields.short: For card payments the default behaviour is to authorise and capture the payment at the same time.

fields.name: cardCreateToken
fields.short: For card payments a payment attempt can be used to create a reusable token for subsequent payments.

fields.name: cardCreateTokenMode
fields.short: This specifies whether user consent will be taken before tokenising card or not.

fields.name: cardIgnoreCVN
fields.short: If set to true the card payment gateway will be directed to proceed with a payment even if the card verification number check fails.

fields.name: cardProcessorMerchantID
fields.short: Optional field that if specified indicates the processor merchant ID that should be used to process any card payments.

fields.name: cardStripePaymentIntentID
fields.short: If Stripe is being used as the card payment processor this property is used to hold the Stripe payment intent ID.

fields.name: cardStripePaymentIntentSecret
fields.short: If Stripe is being used as the card payment processor this property is used to hold the Stripe payment intent client secret.

fields.name: currency
fields.short: The currency of the request.

fields.name: customFields
fields.short: A list of custom fields attached to the payment request.

fields.name: customerEmailAddress
fields.short: Optional email address for the customer.

fields.name: customerID
fields.short: An optional customer identifier for the payment request.

fields.name: description
fields.short: An optional description for the payment request.

fields.name: directDebitPayment
fields.short: Contains information about a Direct Debit payment attempt for a payment request.

fields.name: dueDate
fields.short: The due date for the payment request.

fields.name: failureCallbackUrl
fields.short: Optional callback URL for payment failures that can occur when the payer is redirected away from the payment page.

fields.name: fieldDisplaySettings
fields.short: A list of field display settings that control which fields are displayed to the payer.

fields.name: hostedPayCheckoutUrl
fields.short: This is a convenience link generated for payment requests whose merchants are using hosted payment pages.

fields.name: ignoreAddressVerification
fields.short: If set to true the card payment gateway will be directed to proceed with a payment even if the address verification checks fails.

fields.name: inserted
fields.short: The timestamp the payment request was created at.

fields.name: insertedSortable
fields.short: The Inserted timestamp output as a sortable string https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/standard/base-types/standard-date-and-time-format-strings#UniversalSortable Format also supported natively by Javascript https://tc39.es/ecma262/#se…

fields.name: isArchived
fields.short: Indicates whether the payment request is archived.

fields.name: jwk
fields.short: The jwk containing the public key used to verify the signature of the payment request.

fields.name: lastUpdated
fields.short: The timestamp the payment request was last updated at.

fields.name: lightningInvoice
fields.short: Bitcoin Lightning invoice for the payment request.

fields.name: lightningInvoiceExpiresAt
fields.short: Date and time of expiration of the lightning invoice.

fields.name: merchantDirectDebitMandateID
fields.short: Optional ID of the direct debit mandate associated with this payment request.

fields.name: merchantTokenDescription
fields.short: Description of the merchant token in case the Payment request was created using a merchant token.

fields.name: notificationRoleIDs
fields.short: A list of roles whose members will receive notifications about this payment request.

fields.name: orderID
fields.short: An optional order ID for the payment request.

fields.name: partialPaymentMethod
fields.short: The approach to use, or not, for accepting partial payments.

fields.name: partialPaymentSteps
fields.short: An optional comma separated list of partial payment amounts.

fields.name: paymentAttempts
fields.short: The payment attempts made against this payment request.

fields.name: paymentMethods
fields.short: The payment methods that the payment request supports.

fields.name: paymentProcessor
fields.short: If the card payment option is enabled this field indicates which card processor the merchant is set up to use.

fields.name: payrunID
fields.short: The ID of a payrun that needs an account top up.

fields.name: pispAccountID
fields.short: The payment account ID to use to receive payment initiation payments.

fields.name: priorityBankID
fields.short: The ID of the bank that is set as the priority bank for display on pay element.

fields.name: sandboxSettleDelayInSeconds
fields.short: Sandbox only.

fields.name: status
fields.short: The current status of the payment request.

fields.name: successWebHookUrl
fields.short: If a payment event results in the payment request being classified as fully paid this success webhook URL will be invoked.

fields.name: tags
fields.short: An optional list of descriptive tags attached to the payment request.

fields.name: title
fields.short: A generic field to contain any additional data that the merchant wishes to store against the payment request.

fields.name: useHostedPaymentPage
fields.short: If set to true, and the merchant is configured for hosted payment pages, the base and callback URLs will be set to use the hosted payment page.

fields.name: applePayTransactionID
fields.short: Transaction ID received in Apple pay token.

fields.name: cardAuthorizationResponseID
fields.short: For a successful card authorization this field will hold the response ID.

fields.name: cardExpiryMonth
fields.short: For card payment events this field holds the payer's card expiry month.

fields.name: cardExpiryYear
fields.short: For card payment events this field holds the payer's card expiry year.

fields.name: cardIssuer
fields.short: For card payment events this field holds the payer's card issuer.

fields.name: cardIssuerCountry
fields.short: For card payment events this field holds the payer's card issuer country of origin.

fields.name: cardLastFourDigits
fields.short: For card payment events this field holds the payer's card last four digits.

fields.name: cardScheme
fields.short: For card payment events this field holds the scheme of the payer's card, e.g.

fields.name: cardTokenCustomerID
fields.short: If the option to create a reusable token for card payments was set this field contains the token the merchant can store to use for repeat payments.

fields.name: directDebitPaymentID
fields.short: Payment ID issued by the Direct Debit supplier.

fields.name: directDebitPaymentReference
fields.short: Reference string issued by the Direct Debit supplier.

fields.name: drirectDebitMandateID
fields.short: The ID of the mandate that was used wehn requesting payment.

fields.name: lightningInvoice
fields.short: For Bitcoin Lightning payments this field holds the invoice presented to the payer.

fields.name: lightningRHash
fields.short: For Bitcoin Lightning payments the hash of the invoice presented to the payer.

fields.name: originUrl
fields.short: Optional field that can be set by payment methods, such as pay by bank, that may want to redirect back to the URL that initiated the attempt in the case of a failure condition.

fields.name: paymentMethodType
fields.short: The type of payment method the event relates to, e.g.

fields.name: paymentProcessorName
fields.short: If the event was for a card payment this is the name of the card processor, e.g.

fields.name: pispBankStatus
fields.short: For payment initiation attempts some providers (e.g.

fields.name: pispPaymentInitiationID
fields.short: For a payment initiation this is the ID returned by the service provider initiating the payment for us.

fields.name: pispPaymentInstitutionName
fields.short: For a payment initiation this is the name of the financial institution that is used to initiate and authorise the payment.

fields.name: pispPaymentServiceProviderID
fields.short: For a payment initiation this is the service provider ID selected by the payer, typically the ID for the bank or similar financial institution.

fields.name: pispRedirectUrl
fields.short: For a payment initiation this is the redirect URL returned by the service provider initiating the payment for us.

fields.name: reconciledTransactionID
fields.short: For settlement events (only relevant for non-card payments) this is the payin transaction that the payment request event was reconciled with.

fields.name: refundPayoutID
fields.short: ID of the Payout that was created for refund.

fields.short: For a multi-currency payout this indicates how the Amount and FxDestinationAmount are treated.

fields.short: Optional field to associate the payout with the invoice from an external application such as Xero.

fields.name: isFailed
fields.short: Set to true if a submitted payout subsequently fails.

fields.name: isSettled
fields.short: Set to true if a payout was successfully processed and the corresponding transaction has been recorded on the ledger.

fields.name: isSubmitted
fields.short: Indicates whether the payout has been submitted for processing.

fields.name: merchantID
fields.short: The ID of the merchant that owns the account.

fields.short: The name of the payrun that this payout is associated with.

fields.short: The name of the account the payout is being made from.

fields.name: sourceAccountNumber
fields.short: The account number of the account the payout is being made from.

fields.name: sourceAccountSortcode
fields.short: The sort code of the account the payout is being made from.

fields.short: An optional list of descriptive tags attached to the payout.

fields.name: accountID
fields.short: The ID of the account the rule will apply to.

fields.name: approveUrl
fields.short: If set this property holds the URL an approver needs to visit in order to complete a strong authentication check in order to approve the rule.

fields.name: authenticationMethods
fields.short: A list of authentication types allowed to authorise the payout.

fields.name: authorisations
fields.short: A list of the users who have successfully authorised the latest version of the rule and when.

fields.name: authorisersCompletedCount
fields.short: The number of distinct authorisers that have authorised the rule.

fields.name: authorisersRequiredCount
fields.short: The number of authorisers required for this rule.

fields.name: canAuthorise
fields.short: True if the rule can be authorised by the user who loaded it.

fields.name: description
fields.short: Arbitrary description for the rule.

fields.name: endAt
fields.short: Optional end time for rule executions.

fields.name: hasCurrentUserAuthorised
fields.short: True if the current user has authorised.

fields.name: isDisabled
fields.short: If set to true the rule will be disabled from executing.

fields.name: lastRunAtTransactionDate
fields.short: The most recent transaction date when the rule was last run.

fields.name: merchantID
fields.short: The ID of the merchant that owns the account.

fields.name: name
fields.short: A name to succinctly describe the rule.

fields.name: onApprovedWebHookUrl
fields.short: Optional URL to receive an HTTP request with the rule details when the rule status changes to approved.

fields.name: onExecutionErrorWebHookUrl
fields.short: Optional URL to receive an HTTP request when a rule execution attempt fails.

fields.name: onExecutionSuccessWebHookUrl
fields.short: Optional URL to receive an HTTP request when a rule execution attempt succeeds.

fields.name: startAt
fields.short: Optional start time for rule executions.

fields.name: timeZoneId
fields.short: If the rule should be executed on a recurring schedule this is the timezone that the CRON expression should be evaluated in.

fields.name: triggerCronExpression
fields.short: If the rule should be executed on a recurring schedule this is the expression that sets the schedule.

fields.name: triggerOnPayIn
fields.short: Set to true if the rule execution should be triggered when the account receives a pay in (credit).

fields.name: webHookSecret
fields.short: If set this secret will be used to sign Web Hook requests.

fields.name: accountID
fields.short: The ID of the account the transaction belongs to.

fields.name: accountName
fields.short: The name of the account the transaction belongs to.

fields.name: accountSequenceNumber
fields.short: The sequence number of transaction on a per account basis.

fields.name: amount
fields.short: Amount of the transaction.

fields.name: amountMinorUnits
fields.short: Amount of the transaction expressed in the currency’s minor units (e.g.

fields.name: balance
fields.short: Balance left on the account after the transaction.

fields.name: balanceMinorUnits
fields.short: Balance on the account expressed in the currency’s minor units (e.g.

fields.name: counterpartySummary
fields.short: For pay in (credit) transactions this will contain a descriptive string with the most important fields about the counterparty.

fields.name: currency
fields.short: Currency of transaction.

fields.name: currencyExchange
fields.short: Provides details on the currency exchange.

fields.name: description
fields.short: Description of the transaction.

fields.name: fxAmount
fields.short: For an FX payout this is the amound in the FX currency.

fields.name: fxCurrency
fields.short: For an FX payout this is the currency that was received or that was instructed.

fields.name: fxRate
fields.short: For an FX payout this is the exchange rate between the transaction currency and the FX currency.

fields.name: id
fields.short: Unique ID for the transaction.

fields.name: inserted
fields.short: Date when the transaction was inserted into the ledger.

fields.name: merchantID
fields.short: The ID of the merchant that owns the account.

fields.name: pageNumber
fields.short: Current page number.

fields.name: pageSize
fields.short: Page size

fields.name: payeeDetails
fields.short: The Payee object contains details of the beneficiary, person or business.

fields.name: paymentRequestCustomFields
fields.short: The custom fields that were attached to the payment request that resulted in this transaction.

fields.name: paymentRequestID
fields.short: For Pay by Bank and Direct Debit transactions this will contain the ID of the payment request.

fields.name: payoutID
fields.short: ID of the payout that resulted in the transaction.

fields.name: rawReference
fields.short: The raw payment reference details as received from the payment processor.

fields.name: ruleID
fields.short: ID of the rule that resulted in the transaction.

fields.name: tags
fields.short: An optional list of descriptive tags attached to the transaction.

fields.name: theirReference
fields.short: For a pay out the reference that the payer attached for the receiving party.

fields.name: totalPages
fields.short: Total pages

fields.name: totalSize
fields.short: Total count

fields.name: transactionDate
fields.short: Date when the transaction occurred.

fields.name: type
fields.short: Type of the transaction.

fields.name: virtualIBAN
fields.short: If set it indicates the payin was to a virtual IBAN.

fields.name: yourReference
fields.short: For a pay in the reference the sending party attached.

fields.name: initialRoleID
fields.short: The role ID to automatically assign to the merchant’s very first user.

fields.name: inviteeEmailAddress
fields.short: Email address of the user being invited.

fields.name: inviteeFirstName
fields.short: First Name of the user being invited.

fields.name: inviteeLastName
fields.short: Last Name of the user being invited.

fields.name: isAuthorised
fields.short: Will be set to true once the invite has met the authorisation requirements.

fields.name: isInviteeRegistered
fields.short: If true, indicates the invitee's email address corresponds to an existing MoneyMoov user.

fields.name: merchantID
fields.short: ID of the merchant the user is being invited to.

fields.name: sendInviteEmail
fields.short: If set to true an email will be sent to the invitee with instructions on how to accept the invite.
